2607.11276.title: Automated Textbook Auditing with Multi-Agent LLM Systems
2607.11276.paper_summary: Ensuring the quality of educational materials requires more than standard proofreading: textbooks must be audited for factual accuracy, domain-specific technical correctness, and linguistic quality simultaneously -- a task that general-purpose grammar checkers cannot address. We present \textbf{AI Textbook Auditor}, a modular multi-agent pipeline for automated quality assurance of educational materials across subject domains. The system accepts a textbook PDF and produces a structured, human-reviewable report via two analysis tracks: a \textbf{Factual and Technical Track} in which an ensemble of specialized LLM agents detects factual inaccuracies, code errors, incorrect definitions, and conceptual inconsistencies, augmented with web search for humanities domains; and a \textbf{Grammar Track} operating PDF-natively to preserve diacritical encoding. A \textbf{Judge Agent} filters false positives using domain-specific rules before presenting findings to a human reviewer. The pipeline supports two ingestion modes -- vision-native page rendering and PyMuPDF text extraction -- and is domain-adaptable via custom prompts encoding subject-specific error taxonomies. We demonstrate the system on two Romanian upper-secondary textbooks: a CS textbook (56 technical findings across seven categories, with an expert-validated precision of 62.5\%) and a history and social sciences textbook (72 findings spanning factual errors, ideological bias, and grammar). The system is designed as a triage tool that reduces the manual effort of locating candidate issues, with human expert validation required before any editorial action.
2607.11276.paper_summary_zh: 確保教育材料的質量不僅僅需要標準的校對：教科書必須同時進行事實準確性、領域特定的技術正確性和語言質量的審核——這是一個一般用途的語法檢查工具無法處理的任務。我們提出了\textbf{AI Textbook Auditor}，這是一個模塊化的多代理管道，用於自動化教育材料的質量保證，涵蓋各個學科領域。該系統接受教科書PDF並通過兩個分析路徑生成結構化的、可供人類審閱的報告：\textbf{事實和技術路徑}，其中一組專門的LLM代理檢測事實不準確、代碼錯誤、不正確的定義和概念不一致，並結合人文領域的網絡搜索；以及\textbf{語法路徑}，以PDF原生方式運行以保留變音符號編碼。一個\textbf{Judge Agent}使用領域特定的規則過濾假陽性，然後將結果呈現給人類審閱者。該管道支持兩種攝取模式——視覺原生頁面渲染和PyMuPDF文本提取——並且可以通過自定義提示編碼特定領域的錯誤分類法進行領域適應。我們在兩本羅馬尼亞的高中教科書上演示了該系統：一本計算機科學教科書（七個類別中的56個技術發現，經專家驗證的精確度為62.5\%）和一本歷史與社會科學教科書（72個發現涵蓋事實錯誤、意識形態偏見和語法）。該系統被設計為一種分診工具，減少定位候選問題的人工努力，在任何編輯行動之前需要人類專家的驗證。
